messages.content: The Blue Ridge packet finally came out. Friday packet pickup is 4-7 at Bent Creek, Saturday backup starts at 6:45, and Mark has Monday off. Can we reserve the real plan now?

Yes. Driving from Tampa is the least practical now: too much Friday and Monday in the car. My ranking is: GSP first, with one connection, a 75-85 minute rental drive, and workable Friday pickup; AVL only if it beats the times, which it does not today; CLT is cheaper but adds a long mountain drive on both ends. I’d fly GSP, hold a pay-later rental, and use the Arden lodge rather than downtown.
GSP still needs a connection, right? Can we actually make the Friday pickup?

The best GSP option lands 3:39 p.m. If the flight is on time: deplane and rental by 4:15, drive to Bent Creek, arrive around 5:35. Pickup closes at 7. A delay over an hour means you use the Saturday 6:45 backup instead of racing. AVL lands later and costs more; CLT lands earlier but leaves you driving two-plus hours.
That’s a reasonable fallback. What’s the flight?

Delta Main Cabin: Friday TPA 12:25 p.m. to ATL, ATL 2:45 to GSP, arrive 3:39. Monday GSP 2:18 p.m. to ATL, ATL to TPA, arrive 7:06 p.m. $376 per person, seat selection included, 24-hour free cancellation. American via CLT is $431 and not better; CLT airport option saves about $90 each but adds the drive.
Book Delta if seats can be together. One of us by a window is nice, but adjacent matters more.

Seats available without extra cost: TPA-ATL 18A/18B together, ATL-GSP 7A/7B on the two-seat side, GSP-ATL 8A/8B on the two-seat side, and ATL-TPA 22B/22C together. The last leg is aisle/middle; window pair costs extra. I’d keep the free adjacent pair and recheck later.
Keep the free pair. What should we do for the car?

At GSP: practical choice is Hertz midsize SUV, pay later, $238 total. Compact is $177 but tight for gear after the event. Standard SUV is $296 and probably unnecessary. Hertz counter is open late enough for this arrival; adding Mark as a driver is about $13/day unless his status waives it.
Midsize SUV, pay later, add Mark if it isn't waived. Now lodge versus downtown—what are we giving up?

Arden lodge: 15-20 min to Bent Creek, easy parking, pool, hot tub, fitness room, and in-room coffee. $218/night, refundable until 72 hours before arrival. Caveat: mini-fridges are by request, not guaranteed, though the front desk says supply is usually fine. Downtown inn: better walking to dinner and $196/night, but no hot tub, tiny fitness room, paid parking, and 35-40 min to the trail Saturday.
For this weekend, recovery and being close to the trail beats walkability. Can the lodge do one king or queen, not two doubles?
Yes. Refundables left are a standard king at $218 or mountain-view king at $252. Same coffee setup and same fridge request. Queen is sold out in the refundable category; king is the cleanest fit.
Standard king. I don't care about the view. Breakfast included?

Not included. The café opens at 6:30, which is close to the packet's Saturday arrival window, so I’d plan a grocery stop after Friday packet pickup. I’ll put the mini-fridge request on the reservation and a late-arrival note even though you should be in before dinner.
Good. Spell out the cancellation pieces before you book.

Delta: full refund only within 24 hours of booking; after that, Main Cabin gives fare credit under current rules. Lodge: cancel free until Tuesday at 6 p.m. before arrival; after that first night plus tax. Hertz: pay-later, no prepay, cancellable. Lodge has the pool/hot tub/fitness; the only amenity uncertainty is the fridge.
Go ahead with the flights and lodge, and hold the car.
I’ll book those now. One timing caveat: if the Friday flight is 90 minutes late, don't rush the mountain roads for packet pickup. Use Saturday pickup and go straight to the lodge Friday.
Agreed. Please finish it.

Arden lodge confirmation AL39K8: standard king, Friday-Monday, coffee confirmed, mini-fridge requested, pool/hot tub/fitness confirmed. Hertz GSP pay-later midsize SUV hold HR7712, with Mark noted as possible additional driver. Next follow-up: call the lodge 48 hours out to reconfirm the fridge and hot tub hours.
